ui_projects.approach: I gave immense breathing room to the layout, using expansive whitespace to highlight the lush greenery of the course and keep the booking path effortless.
decisions: Instead of a generic resort template, I wove subtle, sport-aligned details into custom iconography and used real golf terms in the copy to speak directly to an affluent audience.
ui_projects.title: Canterbury Hotel & Golf Resort
ui_projects.overview:
Canterbury’s massive competitive edge as a new resort was bringing luxury golf close to Colombo, saving players long travel times. The goal was to build an elite web presence that highlighted this proximity and exclusivity.

Link - www.canterburygolfresort.lk

ui_projects.approach: I designed a quiet, highly spacious layout with a minimal booking path, echoing the peaceful atmosphere of the physical property.
decisions: Drawing inspiration from their logo and old Dutch architecture, I wove subtle Dutch patterns, soft sea-wave shapes, and purple lotus motifs into the UI, layered with delicate purple watercolor textures.
ui_projects.title: Amaloh Boutique Hotel
ui_projects.overview: A serene beachfront boutique hotel seeking a calm, elegant digital presence that reflects its exclusivity and caters to international guests looking for privacy, comfort, and effortless coastal exploration.

ui_projects.approach: Moving away from standard bright hotel layouts, I built a spacious, modern interface using a dark and organic visual system that matches the physical feel of the property.
decisions: I relied on a deep green and charcoal palette, layering in subtle stone/cement textures and tree-branch shadow play to bring the misty atmosphere of Ella onto the screen.
ui_projects.title: Elevate Ella Hotel
ui_projects.overview: Designed by a renowned Sri Lankan architect, this unique hotel features massive black stone walls integrated directly into misty mountain landscapes. The digital presence needed to mirror this raw, earthy, yet luxurious architecture.

ui_projects.approach: Every skin shares the same structure, so each property gets its own soul without a new build.
decisions: I wove quick cultural insights, like Ayurvedic wellness or local history, directly into the booking path to give international travelers a clear, contextual reason to book.
ui_projects.title: Dickwella Resort & Spa and Ayugiri Ayurveda Wellness Resort
ui_projects.overview: Instead of a copy-pasted template for the entire hotel group, I kept a consistent layout structure but created custom visual “skins” for each location: sea-green and sand-beige for Dickwella, dark forest greens and gold-ish yellows for Ayugiri, and deep scarlets with earthy browns for Sigiriya.

ui_projects.approach: I co-designed the entire site structure, mapping intuitive navigation paths for browsing tour packages, building custom wildlife journeys, and digesting a large database of species and national parks.
decisions: A minimal, nature-focused layout, plus custom, detailed maps I personally illustrated for every major national park in Sri Lanka.
ui_projects.title: Jetwing Eco Holidays
ui_projects.overview: An eco-tourism division of Jetwing Hotels crafting immersive wildlife, wellness, and filming experiences. I collaborated closely with their team to build a user-friendly hub for conscious travelers and global film crews.

ui_projects.approach: A high-conversion pathway for wedding couples and event planners, paired with dedicated, theme-driven menu templates for their Sri Lankan and Japanese restaurants.
decisions: A spacious interface that showcases the resort’s signature lake and greenery, with restaurant sub-pages themed to the culinary vibe of each cuisine.
ui_projects.title: Waters Edge
ui_projects.overview: Located right next to Colombo yet surrounded by lush greenery and a lake, Waters Edge needed a digital presence that balanced its reputation as an elite wedding destination with its high-end dining.

ui_projects.approach: A highly elegant, spacious layout that stays true to their established color palette, focused on comfort and high-quality experiences.
decisions: A custom illustrated map of Sri Lanka and subtle, curved UI motifs inspired by the serifs of their logo font.
ui_projects.title: Travel Design
ui_projects.overview: Operating under Connaissance De Ceylan, this brand designs bespoke Sri Lankan holidays for high-end independent travelers. The goal was a clean, minimalist platform reflecting over 34 years of luxury travel expertise.

ui_projects.approach: A highly elegant, spacious layout that stays true to their established color palette.
decisions: A custom illustrated map of Sri Lanka and curved UI motifs inspired by their logo font.
ui_projects.title: Karusan Travels
ui_projects.overview: Operating under Connaissance De Ceylan, this brand designs bespoke Sri Lankan holidays for high-end independent travelers, with a clean, minimalist platform reflecting over 34 years of expertise.

ui_projects.approach: A light, spacious e-commerce interface that avoids crowded retail grids, making online shopping feel like entering a high-end spa.
decisions: Clean, elegant typography and a soft, minimalist palette that mirrors the light, fresh tones of the product packaging.
ui_projects.title: Koxa by Dr. Cherry
ui_projects.overview: As a luxury, science-driven cosmetics brand under the 360 Group, KOXA needed an upscale e-commerce platform that justified its premium price point to affluent women.

ui_projects.approach: A global ordering system that dynamically manages product lines and package sizes by region, turning a messy logistical backend into a smooth checkout.
decisions: Warm, aged-beige paper tones and subtle, custom tea-stain textures give the store an authentic, storied feel.
ui_projects.title: Hedley’s Tea
ui_projects.overview: A global Ceylon tea brand needing a modern e-commerce platform to streamline international purchasing, while honoring their signature heritage branding.

ui_projects.approach: A clean, modern e-commerce structure showcasing their huge variety of blends, so discovery and checkout feel quick.
decisions: A bold look built on their bright orange, plus clean 3D-rendered style product visuals I crafted manually, long before AI tools made it easy.
ui_projects.title: T-Sips
ui_projects.overview: Backed by four decades of heritage under Expoteas Ceylon, T-Sips has a youthful, vibrant personality. They needed a platform balancing corporate trust with a lively storefront.

ui_projects.approach: A clean, minimalist layout with a vibrant but controlled palette that highlights their core yellow and purple.
decisions: Airy, high-end product photography on soft pastel backgrounds, proving a kids’ brand can be both playful and sophisticated.
ui_projects.title: Viz Kids
ui_projects.overview: Viz Kids imports high-end international children’s clothing to Sri Lanka. The challenge was an e-commerce site that felt premium and trustworthy to parents while keeping a fun, youthful energy.

ui_projects.approach: A highly structured layout that made searching and filtering effortless, turning a cluttered database into a clean digital bookstore.
decisions: A custom 3D look for book previews, paired with tactile hover animations, recreating the nostalgia of browsing a real bookshop.
ui_projects.title: Vijitha Yapa Bookshop
ui_projects.overview: As Sri Lanka’s largest book retailer, Vijitha Yapa needed to replace an outdated website with a modern e-commerce platform that could handle a massive, diverse catalog.

ui_projects.approach: A clean, highly organized interface for business clients that makes complex enterprise catalogs and managed services easy to navigate.
decisions: A sleek, dark palette with precise, tech-inspired UI elements for a sophisticated, cutting-edge feel.
ui_projects.title: TYAX
ui_projects.overview: As a leading enterprise IT distributor across Sri Lanka, Singapore, and the Maldives, TYAX needed a modern B2B platform that signals global scale, technical innovation, and reliability.

ui_projects.approach: A pristine, intuitive interface in clean white and medical blue with subtle brand-orange highlights, so patients can easily book appointments and navigate treatments.
decisions: A main banner where text transitions from heavily blurred to razor-sharp as you read “Step into a world of clarity,” and custom buttons with camera-focus corner markers.
ui_projects.title: Vasan Eye Care Hospital
ui_projects.overview: As Sri Lanka’s first advanced, one-stop eye care hospital, Vasan needed a digital platform that instantly communicated precision, modern medical expertise, and patient trust.

ui_projects.approach: A structured, clean, minimal corporate framework that conveys complex global logistics networks for enterprise clients.
decisions: A sharp orange and black palette, with the one-slashed-edge rectangle from their logo used as a consistent motif.
ui_projects.title: EFL India
ui_projects.overview: As a leading global third-party logistics provider under Expo Lanka operating in 39 countries, EFL 3PL needed a high-caliber corporate website to showcase data-driven supply chain solutions.
